notes.title: Patch notification (v0.0.1.1)
notes.notes:
- In addition to the current email authentication 3-way login method, improved login using PIN without personal information. Selected during initial registration.

- Added item drop function (currently, heroes can interact through shared storage even when they are far away, but it is not intuitive and inconvenient..)

- Changed the design of Artemis, Bagatur hero skins.

- Changed title/battle background music.

- Other minor bug fixes.

We will review other changes to the overall direction of the game (PvE content) over time. ^^

notes.title: Early Access Release Notice (25.01.22.)
notes.notes:
Hello.

This is Raycast Studio.

Our MOBA - Spell of Infinity, which we are developing, has been released on Steam Early Access on 25.01.22.

At this point, it supports 2 maps, 16 heroes, and PvP battles between players and bots.

In the future, we plan to add a story mode that can be played in single-player and small-scale cooperative.

We look forward to your interest.

Thank you.
